comparisons.reason: Same source (OC_comments), dtype, any-comment structure and null rules, but constructs differ in breadth. Feature 0 counts any specific factual data OR verifiable citation (named studies, sources, laws, court cases, links, documented events, dates) without requiring numbers. Feature 1 requires specific numerical data/statistics used as evidence, so a named case or link with no figures counts for 0 but not 1. Feature 1 is a materially narrower subtype, so they are not interchangeable.
